scripts.slides: for s in 1 2; do remotion render src/slides.jsx Slide$s out/slide$s.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq --browser-executable=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium --chrome-mode=headless-shell && ffmpeg -y -i out/slide$s.mov -c:v libx264 -preset slow -b:v 15M -minrate 15M -maxrate 15M -bufsize 15M -x264-params nal-hrd=cbr -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -movflags +faststart -an ../final/slide$s.mp4; done
